subject: Calculate min distance between periodic images

messages.author: Hocine EL KHAOUDI ENYOURY
messages.body:
Dear Amber community,
Is there a way to track the minimum distance between a protein and its periodic image? In Gromacs was possible with gmx mindist -pi. I have tried so far with cpptraj and nativecontacts but I didn’t succeed
Thanks,
Hocine
